* **October 8, 2025 
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
October 7, 2025 ... **\*\*\*NDP Media Advisory for Friday, November 7 Event\*\*\*** **The Nebraska Democratic Party is Proud to Announce President Joe Biden as a Speaker at the 2025 Ben Nelson Gala** The Nebraska Democratic Party (NDP) is excited and honored to announce that President Joe Biden will be a speaker at our 2025 Ben Nelson Gala. President Biden will join Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear and Capitol Police Officer Harry Dunn as featured speakers. Omaha Mayor John Ewing will be our emcee for the evening. Along with this historic lineup of speakers, elected ... To provide the press with advance information, this press advisory contains details about our gala. Members of the ... **WHAT:** Our annual Ben Nelson Gala is a fundraiser and celebration of local party leaders, supporters, and volunteers who strengthen our party and help elect Democrats. We will honor individuals with awards and provide inspirational speeches. In addition to our featured speakers, we will have elected officials, candidates, and party leaders present. Our theme this year will be: “Diverse, Strong, and Ready.” **WHO:**
President Joe Biden
Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear
Omaha Mayor John Ewing January 6th Capitol Police Officer Harry Dunn
Nebraska Democratic Party Chair and DNC Vice Chair Jane Kleeb
